content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT Roorkee Postdoctoral Fellow Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 31-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Roorkee Postdoctoral Fellow positions?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 31st August 2026. It is advisable to submit your application well in advance of the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Postdoctoral Fellow position at IIT Roorkee?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 80,000 per month, along with an additional Rs. 50,000 per annum for contingency expenses.

faq.question: Q3. What are the essential qualifications required for the Postdoctoral Fellow role?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Ph.D. in Chemical Engineering or a related discipline and have at least two research papers published as the first author in SCI-indexed journals.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for the Postdoctoral Fellow position at IIT Roorkee?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to send your resume and required documents to the official email address specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Postdoctoral Fellow position announced by IIT Roorkee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Postdoctoral Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an initial screening of applications, followed by an interview for shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q8. What is the official website of IIT Roorkee?
faq.answer: The official website of the Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee is www.iitr.ac.in.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is ChED/I-PDF/2026/HPV.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The Postdoctoral Fellow position at IIT Roorkee is a contractual job.
